# Shukayu

> Shukayu is a reverse-auction marketplace that connects buyers and sellers of services in Ukraine. Buyers post what they need; sellers send price offers; the buyer picks the best deal.

Site: https://shukayu.com.ua
Languages: Ukrainian (default, /uk), English (/en)

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk): Platform overview, how it works, FAQ
- [Browse requests](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/request): Live buyer service requests for sellers
- [Create request](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/create): Post a free service request as a buyer
- [How it works](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/how-it-works): Step-by-step flow from request to deal
- [About](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/about): Mission and platform principles
- [Contact](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/contact): Contact the Shukayu team
- [Support](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/support): Help and common questions
- [Terms](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/terms): Terms of service
- [Privacy](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/privacy): Privacy policy

English equivalents use the /en prefix (e.g. https://shukayu.com.ua/en/request).

## Product model

1. Buyer creates a request (category, budget, location, urgency).
2. Sellers browse requests and send proposals (price, timeline, warranty).
3. Buyer compares offers, chats with sellers, and accepts one proposal.
4. After the deal, users leave reviews that build profile reputation.
